en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large, two‑story masonry school building with a raised basement, symmetrical façade, and classical portico supported by two columns. The structure has many tall rectangular windows, rusticated stone at the ground level, and a central entrance reached by broad steps. A ventilator or cupola rises from the hipped roof. Trees frame the scene in the foreground, and a dirt or early concrete path leads toward the entrance, with a simple wooden fence and railing. Several bicycles are parked along the side of the building. The image edge shows a black border and some damage at the top, typical of early photographic postcards.
